title: Cyber chief: UK facing AI-powered attacks on critical infrastructure within two years
description: The UK's National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) warns that within two years, AI-powered cyber attacks, including ransomware targeting critical national infrastructure, are highly likely. The report highlights that longstanding cybersecurity weaknesses, exacerbated by underinvestment and 'tech on the cheap,' will be exploited at unprecedented scale and speed due to AI capabilities. The NCSC calls for urgent investment in cyber resilience and foundational security improvements to mitigate these emerging threats. The UK government is investing in cyber defense initiatives, including AI-focused centers and vulnerability detection programs, to strengthen national security.
